title: Typed Sum
question: Implement sumArray with full type annotations: it takes a number[] and returns a number. sumArray([]) must return 0.
constraints: Annotate the parameter and return type.
hints: reduce with an initial value of 0.
The parameter is number[] and the return is number.
bruteForce: A typed for loop accumulating into a number.

discussion.mistakes: Omitting the initial value; using any.
followUps: How would you make it generic over number | bigint?

title: Typed Reverse String
question: Implement reverseString(str: string): string that returns the reversed string.
hints: Both parameter and return are string.

title: Typed Maximum
question: Implement maxValue(arr: number[]): number returning the largest number (handles negatives).
hints: Don't initialize a tracker to 0 (breaks for all-negative).

followUps: Make it generic with a compare function?

title: Typed Unique
question: Implement a generic unique<T>(arr: T[]): T[] that removes duplicates while preserving order.
constraints: Generic over T; return a new array.
optimized: [...new Set(arr)] is O(n) and stays generic.

discussion.mistakes: Losing the generic by typing as any[].
followUps: Dedupe objects by a key with a generic keyFn?

title: Type a User & Format It
question: Define a User type with id: number, name: string, and optional email?: string. Then implement formatUser(u: User): string returning 'name (#id)'. (No automated test — check the console output.)
constraints: email is optional; annotate the function.
hints: Use interface User { ... } with email?: string.
bruteForce: Inline object type works but a named interface is reusable.

followUps: How would Partial<User> help an update function?

title: Machine Coding: Generic identity<T>
question: Implement identity<T>(x: T): T that returns its argument unchanged, preserving the type.
constraints: Preserve the input type with a generic.
hints: A single type parameter T flows in and out.

title: Machine Coding: pluck<T, K extends keyof T>
question: Implement pluck(arr, key): return an array of the given property from each object. Type it so key must be a real key of T.
constraints: Constrain K to keyof T so invalid keys are compile errors.
hints: K extends keyof T constrains the key.

title: Machine Coding: lastItem<T>
question: Implement lastItem<T>(arr: T[]): T | undefined returning the last element, or undefined for an empty array.
constraints: Return type must include undefined for the empty case.
hints: The return type is T | undefined.
